---
name: Feature request
about: Something the tool should be able to do and cannot
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?**
The task, not the feature. What are you extracting, and what for?

**How do you do it today?**
Whether that is a workaround here, another tool, or not at all.

**What would the tool have to do?**
As concretely as you can put it.

**Have you checked the roadmap?**
[docs/ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/MartinHoblisch/pbf-forge/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md) lists what is planned, what is under
consideration, and what is deliberately out of scope. If it is already there,
say so in a comment on the existing issue instead: which requests have real
users behind them is what decides the order.
